historical_package_observation.observation: An older exact package let Generate plan advance to Review without a coordinator and then showed an error. No provider ran.

current_product_source.implementation: plan_configuration_available requires a non-empty goal and a coordinator ID present in registered profiles; the Generate plan button includes that predicate in its enabled state.

scope: The regression is fixed and verified at source level in the current product code. The older package observation is not evidence of current package behavior; exact-package UI revalidation is still required. No product code changed in this verification.
